Joshua Foster pleaded guilty over death of toddler who fell from fourth-floor window of hotel during family holiday

A British man has been fined €3,000 (£2,500) after his two-year-old son fell 10 metres (33ft) to his death from the fourth-floor window of a hotel in Cyprus.

Joshua Foster thought the window was closed when he approached it with the boy to show him the view of a waterpark and “lost control” of him, the court previously heard.

India police detain ‘Cockroach’ party founder ahead of protest Indian police detained Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke ahead of a protest.
India's 'cockroach' party founder detained ahead of protest The youth-led movement had called for a Delhi protest after mass detentions last week and the jailing of two leaders.

sources.snippet: A teenager shot and killed three children and a teacher on Thursday at an elementary school in the US state of Oregon, police said, adding the assailant was later killed by an armed bystander who pursued him into the building. Officers rushed to Silver Rail Elementary in Bend, a city of about 100,000 in the nation's northwest, after reports of a shooter on campus on Thursday afternoon. The three children who died on the scene were aged five, eight and 11, said Bend police chief Mike Krantz.
sources.title: Shooter kills teacher, three children at Oregon elementary school

sources.snippet: Between 400 and 450 children attend Silver Rail Elementary, where more than 40 staff work, a police spokesperson had said earlier.
sources.title: Three children and one teacher killed in Oregon elementary school shooting
